developmentStatement: Every US date in the evaluation window (2012-01 to 2024-08) is outcome-exposed: SPY over this span and the valuation-return literature were known to the authors before this protocol was written. Nothing this protocol can produce from that history is confirmatory. Only the prospective record (Phase 3) can confirm.

governance.krPhaseD: Korean historical exploration is closed (docs/kr-alpha-research-final-development-assessment.md). A Korean historical outcome test of this protocol needs a separate, explicit owner exception before any KR outcome is read; without it every KR cell is NOT_RUN and only source building and prospective recording are allowed.
governance.usExposure: US history is outcome-exposed and is never described as a confirmatory sample.
governance.sealedStudies: No sealed study, spec, result, lock or prospective ledger is modified by this protocol.

cashAsset.rule: BIL total return = raw close plus ISSUER distributions (dividend + capital gains) reinvested at the ex-date close. Vendor distribution events are never used where they disagree with or omit issuer events. No synthetic pre-inception history (inception 2007-05-30; the window starts 2012). A reference rate (TB3MS / DGS3MO accrual) is a labelled sensitivity only: REFERENCE_RATE_NOT_INVESTABLE.

equityReturnSource.rule: Issuer NAV / distribution reconciled series only; replay-v16 069500 carries an unexplained accrual (v2.46-v2.47) and is not used.

cashAsset.rule: KOFR exists only from 2021-11-26; CD91 is not among the ECOS probe's reviewed semantic names, so no item is selected by guess. BOK policy-rate results are labelled BOK_POLICY_RATE_PROXY and never called realised performance.

KR.statusNote: Korean historical outcome tests need an explicit owner exception (Phase D). Source builds below are for the prospective record and for that exception, and are not blocked by a missing local credential.

calendar.decisionDate: last exchange session of each calendar month in the ETF's own market
calendar.signalInformation: values with effectiveAt <= decision date only
calendar.execution: close of the next exchange session after the decision date
calendar.returnMeasurement: from execution close to the next execution close; forward horizons measured from the execution close
calendar.missingSignal: a policy holds its previous target unless every completion of its missing inputs gives the same weight; before its first determinable target it holds 0.8

evaluationWindowUS.reason: First month-end at which every input of every registered US policy is determinable (D1 needs 252 SPY sessions; the repository SPY file starts 2011-01-03). Last month whose average price is complete in the pinned Shiller vintage (its 2024-09 row is a partial month). Fixed here, before any outcome.

signals.VALUATION_CHEAP: PE(t) < mean of the PE values recorded at the 60 PRIOR decision dates (>= 54 measured); PE with non-positive earnings is missing
signals.EARNINGS_STABLE: EPS(t) >= EPS(t-3 decision dates), both as recorded at their own decision dates
signals.CREDIT_PERCENTILE_METHOD: type 7 linear interpolation over the 60 PRIOR decision-date values
signals.CREDIT_STRESS: spread(t) > P75 of prior 60 AND spread(t) > spread(t-3)
signals.DEEP_DRAWDOWN: raw close(t) / max raw close over the 252 sessions ending at t (inclusive) - 1 <= -0.20; any missing session -> missing

US_TRAILING_PE.source: Shiller ie_data.xls, shillerdata.com hosted asset, Last-Modified 2024-09-04
US_TRAILING_PE.price: column P: monthly average of daily S&P Composite closes for month M (complete at the end of M); the file's final row is a partial month and is never used
US_TRAILING_PE.earnings: column E read ONLY at quarter-end months (Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec); at the end of decision month M the usable quarter is the latest quarter-end q <= M - 4 months
US_TRAILING_PE.lagRationale: The two reachable vintages show their last earnings month 2.17 and 3.58 months before their Last-Modified dates; intra-quarter months are interpolated towards the NEXT quarter-end value and so are never read. 4 > 3.58. This is a conservative lag on a single revised vintage, NOT a verified publication date.
US_TRAILING_PE.revisionEvidence: Between the 2023-10-17 and 2024-09-04 vintages, E differs only for 2023-04..2023-06 (<= 0.09%), D never, P only on the older file's partial final month.

US_FORWARD_PE_AND_EPS.reason: No repository secret or preserved artifact carries a dated forward-EPS ledger (FMP / Finnhub / SimFin / Polygon / AlphaVantage keys serve company statements, not an index consensus ledger). FactSet Insight posts quote the forward 12-month P/E in text, but the public archive holds 32 'earningsinsight' posts for 2017 and one for 2012 among 836 listed slugs, extraction is unvalidated and redistribution rights are unverified. A forward variant needs its own source build and preregistration; current-vintage estimates are never backfilled.

US_CREDIT_SPREAD.definition: BAA (Moody's seasoned Baa, monthly) minus GS10 (monthly). For decision session d each leg is the latest observation in the ALFRED vintage in force on the calendar day BEFORE d (an H.15 release on d lands after the 16:00 close). The two legs must carry the same observation month, else the spread is missing.

rejectedAlternatives.BAMLH0A0HYM2 / BAMLC0A0CM: FRED now serves only the last three years (first observation 2023-11-21); not a historical source.
rejectedAlternatives.BAA10Y: No ALFRED vintage before 2014-06; robustness only from 2019 onwards, never substituted.
rejectedAlternatives.DBAA: Not in ALFRED (current vintage served for any date).

US_CREDIT_SPREAD.missing: a missing vintage or observation makes the spread missing; it is never replaced by VIX, a rate or another spread
US_CREDIT_SPREAD.route: public alfredgraph.csv (no credential); the Actions FRED_API_KEY route serves the same vintages and is not needed

US_DRAWDOWN_CLOSE.note: raw price close for the signal, total-return close for the outcome; never mixed

KR_PE.officialIndexPer: KRX Data Marketplace MDCSTAT00702 (KOSPI 200 PER/PBR/dividend yield). Answered HTTP 400 LOGOUT here; the same portal answered LOGOUT on Actions for investor flow (v2.25). The subscribed KRX Open API (KRX_API_KEY) serves idx/kospi_dd_trd and idx/krx_dd_trd, whose published field list carries index levels, volume, value and market cap but no PER; to be confirmed from a served row before this is called a coverage limit.
KR_PE.bottomUpRoute: Aggregate PER of the PIT Top-120 from repository-preserved inputs: KRX daily MKTCAP (KRX_API_KEY universe snapshots on signal-history) over DART TTM net income (DART key, kr-candidate-merged store). Differs from KRX's official index PER (constituents, float, treatment of losses) and is registered as its own definition; DART coverage starts 2015 and covers 126 of 260 ever-Top-120 tickers.

KR_FORWARD_EPS.reason: No repository secret reaches a Korean consensus ledger; FnGuide/FnSpace is ToS-blocked (challenger-2 feasibility). DART serves filed results, not forecasts.

KR_CREDIT_SPREAD.evidence: Actions run 37080934658 (probes.yml ecos-market-context, secrets.ECOS) validated KTB 3Y 817Y002/010200000 (daily, 1998-11-13..) and listed CorpBond 3Y AA- 817Y002/010300000 (daily, 1995-01-03..) and BBB- 010320000 (2000-09-30..) as AMBIGUOUS only because two ratings exist.
KR_CREDIT_SPREAD.registeredChoice: AA- (investment-grade, longest history), chosen here before any value is read.
KR_CREDIT_SPREAD.valueCollection: The probe saves no values by design. Daily values need a reviewed collector step calling pipeline/ecos_macro.py with secrets.ECOS; none exists today and no new workflow is created in this PR.
KR_CREDIT_SPREAD.vintage: ECOS history is REVISED_HISTORY with no release-vintage endpoint; market yields are observed, but publishedAt stays null.

M1T.rule: not stable AND stress -> 0.6; stable AND not stress -> 1.0; else 0.8

VM1T.rule: priority 1: not stable AND stress -> 0.6; priority 2: cheap AND stable AND not stress -> 1.0; else 0.8

preOutcomeDecisions.decision: The proposal's VM1/M1 need forward EPS, which is SOURCE_BLOCKED. They stay registered as VM1F/M1F with status SOURCE_BLOCKED. VM1T/M1T are SEPARATE policies using trailing reported EPS, registered here before any outcome, and are never reported under the VM1/M1 names.
Forward and trailing PER are never pooled. With forward PER blocked, the primary valuation claim is H1-US-TRAILING.
US window 2012-01-31..2024-08-30 (152 decisions) from input availability alone.
Before its first determinable target a dynamic policy holds 0.8, the middle registered weight.
A 60-month history statistic needs at least 54 measured values (90%).

hypotheses.claim: Mean 12-month SPY-minus-cash total-return excess after VALUATION_CHEAP (trailing PE) decisions exceeds the mean after not-cheap decisions
hypotheses.statistic: difference of conditional means of forward 12M excess

hypotheses.claim: VM1T's cost-net TIMING term (#316 decomposition) is positive

multipleTesting.family: hypotheses with holmFamily PRIMARY at Phase 2 execution; an unavailable cell is reported NOT_RUN or SOURCE_BLOCKED and is never counted as a failure

inference.independentBlockRule: fewer than 10 non-overlapping 12-month blocks -> no strong statistical conclusion; the US window holds 12 (152 months)
secondary: V1, M1T, D1, B1, B2 comparisons
state cells below MIN_STATE_CELL_DECISIONS are descriptive only

implementation.rule: Imported if #316 is merged before Phase 2; otherwise that exact blob is vendored and its git blob hash is checked before use. Never re-derived.

attribution.residual: compounded NAV difference minus the arithmetic decomposition is reported as drift / rebalance residual

US.basis: SPY / BIL half-spread plus fees, conservative; no tax

KR.basis: 1.5bp commission + 4bp half-spread; domestic equity ETF sale is exempt from securities transaction tax

economicThresholds.level3AlphaPath: cost-net CAGR above B0 AND above the exposure-matched static, with prospective confirmation
economicThresholds.level3RiskPath: lower MDD and worst-12M than B0 and than a static of equal volatility, with the return given up quantified; never called alpha

dca.contribution: 1 unit on the first decision date of every month, identical for every DCA rule
dca.DCA-A: invest the whole contribution at execution
dca.DCA-B: not cheap: invest 50%, park 50% in cash; cheap: invest the contribution and all parked cash
dca.DCA-C: not deep drawdown: invest 50%, park 50%; deep drawdown: invest the contribution and all parked cash
dca.terminal: parked cash at the end is valued at cash, never force-invested
dca.neverComparedWith: the overlay policies in one table

robustness: 2008 crisis (outside US window; descriptive only if a longer verified SPY series is built)
median instead of mean for PE5
USD vs KRW reporting (causal FX only)
stopConditions: a revised value enters a decision outside its registered lag rule
threshold-only re-search on the same history
signal redundant with the existing trend / risk overlay
predictive power without cost-net portfolio improvement (record, then stop the policy path)

prospectiveRecord.blocker: No live trailing-PE source: Shiller's maintained file (shillerdata.com) reset the connection here and the reachable copies end 2024-09; S&P DJI's EPS workbook answered 403 here. Both are to be re-measured from an Actions runner before this is called an access block; a live receipt also needs a separate authorization.
prospectiveRecord.outcomes: 6M and 12M outcomes stored separately after maturity; append-only

order: 4 SOURCE_BLOCKED only after authentication, access or the source's own coverage is shown to refuse
sourceAcquisitionPolicy.rule: A credential absent from the development container is never a reason for SOURCE_BLOCKED. Secrets are read only by reviewed workflows on main; they are never printed, copied, committed or handed to unreviewed PR code.
sourceAcquisitionPolicy.dispatchFromThisSession: workflow_dispatch answers 403 Resource not accessible by integration for this session's token; a run that needs a secret is reported with its exact path and inputs for the owner to dispatch.

preOutcomeReadiness.source: research/market_valuation_macro_overlay_v1/evidence/us-signal-readiness.json (states and targets only; no return read)
preOutcomeReadiness.cellRule: A state cell (2x2 table, trend x valuation table) with fewer than 12 decision dates is DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY: no interval, no test, no ranking.

facts.creditStress: 15 true, 130 false, 7 missing (BAA vintages stuck at 2016-09 for the 2016-11..2017-02 decisions; the 3-month widening then needs three more months)
facts.creditTiming: Monthly-average BAA is published early in the following month, so at the 2020-03-31 decision the latest spread is February's and CREDIT_STRESS reads false. This is the registered PIT behaviour, not a defect to tune.

consequences: The proposal's central A-versus-B comparison (cheap with good versus cheap with deteriorating earnings and credit) is NOT_EVALUABLE in the US window: CHEAP_BAD has 1 decision and NOT_CHEAP_BAD 7. Both are reported descriptively only.
D1 differs from B1 on 3 decisions; D1 is a near-copy of B1 here and its comparison is reported descriptively only.
VM1T reaches 0.6 on 8 decisions; its exposure variation is mostly 0.8 versus 1.0, driven by the CHEAP_GOOD state.
